questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Stop completely at the intersection.
Keep driving at your normal speed.
Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be alert. Drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do when you see an accident?

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Keep moving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not arrived.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident scene if you are involved or emergency help has not arrived. Watch the road and keep moving. Do not stop just to look at the accident.

questions.question: Is night driving more dangerous than day driving?

options.text: No, it is less dangerous.
No, it is equally dangerous.
Yes, it is more dangerous.
No, it is easier on your eyes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it is more dangerous.
questions.explanation: Night driving is more dangerous than day driving. It is harder to see in the dark. Headlight glare from other cars can blind you. More tired and impaired drivers are on the road at night.

questions.question: Can drivers park in the access aisle next to a handicap parking space?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: No one may park in handicap access aisles. These aisles provide space for wheelchairs and wheelchair lifts.

questions.question: What color and shape are construction zone signs?

options.text: Square or rectangular with white and red.
Round or octagonal with black and yellow.
Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.

questions.correctAnswerText: Diamond-shaped or rectangular with orange and black.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs have an orange background with black letters or symbols. You will see them on the right side of the road or on both sides if the road is divided.

questions.question: What does a red arrow on a traffic light mean?

options.text: You may turn after slowing down and checking for traffic.
You cannot turn until the light turns green.
You may turn after coming to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn until the light turns green.
questions.explanation: A red arrow means stop. You must wait until a green light or green arrow appears. Do not turn on a red arrow.

questions.question: When turning left, which traffic light gives you the right-of-way?

options.text: A steady green light
A flashing yellow light
A green arrow pointing left
A flashing red light

questions.correctAnswerText: A green arrow pointing left
questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing left gives you the right-of-way. Oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.question: What does a single dashed white line between lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass, even if it is dangerous.
Lanes are moving in opposite directions.
You may not pass.
You may pass if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes moving in the same direction. Dashed white lines can be crossed to pass or change lanes if it is safe.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Pass on the right whenever possible.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
Get ahead of slow traffic so you can see better.
Always flash lights and honk to alert other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Each time you pass, you increase the chance of a collision. If you drive faster than others, you will have to keep passing. Drive with traffic flow at the legal speed limit and pass only when needed.

questions.question: Should you use high beam headlights when driving in fog?

options.text: True
False

questions.correctAnswerText: False
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights in fog. Use low beam headlights or fog lights instead.

questions.question: What does a double solid yellow line down the center of a road mean for passing?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed only from your direction.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means traffic moves in opposite directions. No passing is allowed from either direction.

questions.question: When driving at night, you should:

options.text: Always use your high beams.
Look directly at oncoming headlights.
Increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: At night, increase the distance between your car and the car ahead. Use your headlights properly. Do not look directly at oncoming headlights as the glare will blind you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road gets wider ahead.
The right lane ends soon.
A highway entrance ramp is ahead.
The left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane ends ahead.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?

options.text: Press your brakes hard.
Take your foot off the gas pedal.
Use your parking brake.
Pump your brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal.
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas pedal. If you need to slow down more, gently press the brake pedal with slow, steady pressure.

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: A slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. These vehicles travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does a diamond-shaped sign tell drivers?

options.text: It warns of existing or possible hazards.
It alerts drivers to school zones.
It alerts drivers to public recreation areas.
It alerts drivers to food and gas locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns of existing or possible hazards.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about hazards. These signs are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator sticks while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to park.
Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal.
Turn off the engine.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: Keep your eyes on the road. Quickly shift to neutral and press the brake pedal with steady pressure. When safe, pull off the road and turn off the engine.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Speed up.
Stop completely.
Turn on your headlights.
Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns of a hazard. Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.question: You see a sign that says "Reduced speed, 35 mph." What does this mean?

options.text: The 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
The 35 mph speed limit starts at the next speed limit sign.
You have plenty of time to slow down before reaching the reduced speed zone.
You should reduce your speed to 35 mph only in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: The 35 mph speed limit starts at this sign.
questions.explanation: A "Reduced speed" sign means you must slow down. The new speed limit starts at this sign.

questions.question: You are driving on a city street and see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights behind you. What should you do?

options.text: Drive to the right edge and slow down.
Drive to the right edge and stop.
Stay in your lane, slow down, and let it pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the right edge and stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to any emergency vehicle using its siren and lights. Drive to the right edge and stop until it passes. If you are in an intersection, drive through first, then stop.

questions.question: If a tire blows out, what should you do?

options.text: Press hard on the brake and hold it.
Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.
Pull over quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel tight and brake gently.
questions.explanation: When a tire blows out, grip the steering wheel firmly and keep the car straight. Slow down gradually by easing off the gas and braking softly. Do not stop on the road. Pull to a safe spot off the road.

questions.question: What do rumble strips do?

options.text: They warn drivers about tire problems.
They test a vehicle's shock absorbers.
They make noise and vibrations to wake drivers who are drifting out of their lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: They make noise and vibrations to wake drivers who are drifting out of their lane.
questions.explanation: Rumble strips create noise and vibrations to alert drowsy or distracted drivers that they are leaving the road or approaching a stop sign or traffic light.

questions.question: When can you drink alcohol in a vehicle on a public road?

options.text: As long as you are not driving.
If you sit in the back seat.
If you sit in the back of a pickup truck.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink or carry open alcohol in a vehicle on any public road. You cannot have an open alcohol container in the driver or passenger area of a vehicle on a public road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
Children are playing ahead.
A pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or close to the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Motorist services.
Construction and maintenance.
Distance information to nearby locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorist services.
questions.explanation: Blue signs show motorist services. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other helpful services nearby.
